description: This file contains unit tests for heterogeneous silo configurations in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes test classes, configuration setup, and test methods to validate grain placement strategies, grain type exclusion, and resolver merging behaviors.

classes.name: HeterogeneousTests
classes.description: Test class for verifying heterogeneous silo behaviors, including grain type exclusions and resolver merging.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo-specific services, including type management and placement strategies.

classes.name: ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures client-specific settings such as type map refresh interval.

methods.name: SetupAndDeployCluster
methods.description: Initializes and deploys a test Orleans cluster with specified placement strategy and blacklisted grain types.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the test cluster after tests complete.

methods.name: GrainExcludedTest
methods.description: Tests that a specific grain type is excluded from the cluster configuration, expecting an exception when attempting to access it.

methods.name: MergeGrainResolverTests
methods.description: Runs parameterized tests for various grain placement strategies and resolver behaviors.

methods.name: MergeGrainResolverWithClientRefreshTests
methods.description: Runs tests for resolver merging with client refresh scenarios.

methods.name: CallITestGrainMethod
methods.description: Invokes method on ITestGrain interface to verify interaction.

methods.name: MergeGrainResolverTestsImpl
methods.description: Core implementation for testing grain resolver logic under different configurations and cluster states.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Async initialization method, currently a no-op.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Async cleanup method to stop all silos and dispose of the cluster.
